art_note: The imagery relies on generic mockup and marketplace aesthetics rather than high-end fashion campaign standards.
desc_en: A refined silhouette defines this sleeveless midi dress, tailored with a clean and fluid drape. The design features a subtle front pleated detail and functional side pockets, merging everyday convenience with a polished aesthetic. Crafted from lightweight polyester fabric, it provides continuous comfort and a sophisticated presence for any occasion. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta depurada define este vestido midi sin mangas, concebido con una moderna caída fluida. El diseño incorpora un sutil detalle de pliegues frontales y bolsillos laterales funcionales, combinando versatilidad con una estética limpia. Confeccionado en tejido ligero de poliéster, ofrece comodidad continua y una presencia refinada para cualquier ocasión. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
